output.explanation: NIG-DE booked invoice AE-ICINV-00794 (secondment M. Smith, P-24017) as EUR 3,199.99 (line NIG-DE:5100873428) against NIG-AE's AED 13,200.00 receivable (NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031361).
